text:
Sam (PM): Heads-up: I'm exploring key templates and role-based warnings for credential creation. Idea: templates like `service-read`, `service-admin`, `short-lived-integration` to speed creator flows.
Hannah (design): Love templates. Need to surface scope differences clearly. Maybe an affordance that shows 'what this template grants' inline as pill list.
Owen (eng): Backend needs to attach template_id to key metadata. Also templates should prefill expiration and recommended rotation cadence. For short-lived: default 1h TTL and auto-rotate hints.
Lina (a11y): A11y: when selecting a template, announce the grant list. Use aria-describedby for the template card: "template-grants-<id>".
Sam (PM): Copy: template selection label: "Choose a key template" with helper text: "Templates pre-configure scopes and expiry. Review before creating."
Hannah (design): For admin templates, add an inline warning pill "Admin scope - audited" with a tooltip explaining audit requirements.
Owen (eng): Also, if a user picks admin and is not an org admin, block creation and show a 'Request admin key' flow that creates an approval request.
QA-bot: test: create key with admin template as non-admin -> expected: 403 + 'Request approval' prompt.
Lina (a11y): Approval dialog must support keyboard focus trap and accessible error messages if request fails. Use role="dialog" and focus on first input.
Sam (PM): Expiry UX: show expiration dropdown presets (1h, 24h, 7d, never). When 'never' chosen, show a soft warning 'Non-expiring keys are risky' with a required confirm toggle.
Hannah (design): Visual idea: timeline preview under presets showing expiry and suggested rotate cadence. For 'short-lived-integration' show 'auto-rotate enabled' badge.
Owen (eng): Implementation: for auto-rotate we expose webhook that posts new secret to owner endpoint. Need to warn on create: 'We will send new secret to: https://your-callback.example/current-key'.
Lina (a11y): Any callback URLs shown must be keyboard-selectable and use aria-label 'destination endpoint'. Also when secret delivered, announce 'New secret delivered to callback' via aria-live.
Sam (PM): Revoke UX: when revoking admin keys created via template, require an audit reason and optional rollback plan field. Copy: 'Provide reason for audit log.'
Hannah (design): Empty-state for templates: 'No templates yet. Create a template to standardize key creation across teams.' include a 'Create template' CTA and sample template presets.
Owen (eng): Edge: template updates shouldn't retroactively change existing keys. We'll version templates and show template version at key detail.
QA-bot: test: edit template -> ensure pre-existing key retains old scopes/version.
Lina (a11y): Final a11y checklist: announce template selection, trap focus on approval dialogs, role=status for toasts, descriptive labels for expiry presets, and ensure confirmation flows are keyboard friendly.
Sam (PM): Thanks all — I'll add mocks and a short flow doc. Plan to ship templates MVP behind a feature flag next sprint. Drop any objections here.
Hannah (design): :+1:
Owen (eng): fine by me.
Lina (a11y): I'll review keyboard flows once prototype up.
QA-bot: all green for template smoke tests.
